title: Which is the better buy?
prompt: Offer 1: {q1} units for ${p1}. Offer 2: {q2} units for ${p2}. Which is the better buy?

reduces_to.question: compare-fractions
reduces_to.note: Compare the prices per unit p1/q1 and p2/q2; the smaller one is the better buy, so 'first' (bigger) maps to 'second'.

decimal.name: Price per unit
decimal.idea: Find the cost of 1 unit in each offer; lower is better.

unit_rate.name: Units per dollar
unit_rate.idea: Find how much $1 buys; more is better.

common_denominator.name: Common quantity
common_denominator.idea: Price both offers at the same quantity.

match_denominator.name: Scale one offer to the other's size
match_denominator.idea: What would offer 1 cost for {q2} units?

scale_factor.name: Compare growth
scale_factor.idea: Price grows by {p2} ÷ {p1}, quantity by {q2} ÷ {q1}; quantity growing faster means offer 2 is better.
